dedupe_keys.name: gem global seismic risk map v2026 1

description: The Global Seismic Risk Map of the GEM Foundation shows the geographic distribution of the average annual number of residential, commercial and industrial buildings destroyed by earthquakes, and its release also covers economic losses, built-up area destroyed, fatalities, population rendered homeless and equivalent embodied carbon loss. Version v2026.1 updates the maps released in 2018 and 2023, and it is computed from GEM's global hazard, exposure and vulnerability models with the OpenQuake engine. Coverage: global. Access: an online geoviewer, high resolution PNG maps, a PDF poster and documentation; the underlying data can be requested as a shapefile. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the published maps; the shapefile is free for research and public-good uses and licensed for a fee for commercial use. Caveats: the product page was read through a fetch summary because the site rate-limited direct reads, and values are model averages, not observed losses. Simulation uses are comparing seismic building risk between regions, prioritising retrofit and preparedness, and checking national risk models. Related records: the GEM Global Exposure Model, the GEM global vulnerability model, the GEM global seismic hazard map and the OpenQuake engine.
